senses.gloss: (v.שָׂרַף I) to absorb, quaff, sip, suck.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:5">Ab. Zar. II, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 29b:6">29ᵇ</cite>) <he>שׂורְפָהּ חיה</he> (not <he>שורפו</he>) sucks it (the maw) out raw, v. <cite ref="C01020"><he>גְּמִי</he> I</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite>.
